entities.label: Source asset
invariants: Stored digest and measurements describe immutable media bytes
Frame-aligned source intervals never exceed the decoded frame count

entities.label: Assembly timeline
invariants: The first span has no crossfade
Neighbor crossfade does not exceed either span duration

entities.label: Render job
invariants: A completed job has output metadata and a receipt
A failed job never exposes a partial published output

entities.label: Render receipt
invariants: Receipt digest matches published output bytes
Measured peak respects the requested normalization target tolerance

state_machines.subject: render_job
invariants: completed cannot return to an active state
failed stores a stable error code and message
only completed jobs resolve output and receipt resources

state_machines.subject: timeline
invariants: ready timelines have only resolvable source references
failed validation never persists a record

extension_seams.distinct_outcome: Additional integer PCM layouts can be admitted without changing timeline or storage contracts.
A dynamics stage or alternate amplitude target can change output while preserving job and receipt contracts.

extension_seams.anchor: internal/domain TimelineSpan validation and render span evaluation
extension_seams.distinct_outcome: Automation curves or cue markers can be added as span metadata with observable placement changes.

extension_seams.anchor: internal/storage Repository interface used by service workflows
extension_seams.entry: source, timeline, and render service methods
extension_seams.distinct_outcome: A transactional repository can replace local file persistence without changing HTTP contracts.

tension_points.description: Strict format acceptance versus salvaging a partially readable media payload
tension_points.observable_failure: A malformed or truncated WAV becomes visible as a source, or measured frame metadata disagrees with stored bytes.

tension_points.description: Honoring an aggressive crossfade request versus keeping both source intervals and neighbor bounds intact
tension_points.observable_failure: An impossible crossfade is silently clamped, causing a timeline duration or sample placement different from the stored plan.

tension_points.description: Reaching a requested peak target versus preserving headroom and publishing only self-consistent files
tension_points.observable_failure: The receipt claims the target peak while output samples clip, or a failed render leaves a downloadable partial file.
